about: Rulings for tools/citations.py: page-locator anchors that are not printed text on the cited pages, and quotes printed there that the extracted text does not show in reading order. Keyed by document and the exact anchor or quote. status: proposed (written by the agent) or accepted (owner).

anchors.reason: The proposed regulation's section heading, § 1.163-16, is printed on p. 19, where its text begins; pp. 20–22 carry paragraphs (d)(2) to (d)(6), which each locator names after the section.
Notice 2025-69 prints its divisions as 'III.' (p. 12), 'B.' (p. 20) and '2.'; pp. 22–25 carry paragraph 2's methods (A) to (G), which each locator names after the section.
Rev. Proc. 2024-40 prints its subsections as '.32' under SECTION 3; the heading the locator names next, '.32 Threshold for Excess Business Loss', is printed on p. 17.
Within the Schedule 3 instructions (which begin before p. 115), p. 117 prints the heading as 'Line 11' with 'Excess Social Security and Tier 1 RRTA Tax Withheld'.

anchors.anchor: Schedule 3 line 11 — Excess Social Security and Tier 1 RRTA Tax Withheld
anchors.reason: As for 'Schedule 3 line 11': p. 117 prints 'Line 11' and 'Excess Social Security and Tier 1 RRTA Tax Withheld' under the Schedule 3 instructions.
Describes the table printed on p. 12 under the mid-quarter (MQ) convention: placed in service during the 1st to 4th quarter, 0.875, 0.625, 0.375, 0.125.

anchors.anchor: the items named in the screens of this Schedule C
anchors.reason: Cites the screening gate and its refusal, which together cover statutory employee and notary income, passive and rental activities, businesses owned with a spouse, other accounting methods and the special items; each is described on its own page of pp. 2–15, so there is no single printed heading.

quotes.quote: The amount of the new loan that is an SPVL is limited to the outstanding balance of the refinanced loan as of the date of the refinancing
quotes.reason: Printed verbatim on p. 21; the extracted text puts the page's filing stamp ('tkelley on LAP7H3WLY3PROD with PROPOSALS2') between 'new' and 'loan'.

quotes.quote: No. Check the box in the Dependents section that discusses the special rule for separated spouses
quotes.reason: The 'No.' box of Step 3, question 6, on p. 41; its lines are printed beside the 'Yes. STOP' box, and the extracted text interleaves the two boxes line by line.
The EIC Table's column heads 'At least' and 'But less than' and its first row, 1 and 50, on p. 49; the extracted text reads the table cells in column order, not as a sentence.
As for 'At least 1 But less than 50': the column head and the first row's value are separate table cells on p. 49.
